item.title: PHP Accessing Object Properties With Dashes How To Do It
item.description:
“PHP Accessing Object Properties With Dashes How To Do It”

When dealing with object properties that include characters invalid for standard identifiers, such as hyphens, PHP requires alternative syntax for both assignment and retrieval. The key is treating the property name as a string within the access notation.

Direct Access with String Notation (The Primary Fix)

The most direct method to handle properties with special characters like hyphens is by using the curly brace syntax, similar to array access but with the object operator (->).
